name: Arachnophobia
summary: Arachnophobia is a Horde bounty quest targeting Besseleth, an ancient and colossal predator haunting southern Stonetalon Mountains. Posted on a roadside notice near Windshear Crag, the bounty directs adventurers into Sishir Canyon to claim the spider matriarch's fang for Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat. Putting an end to her reign makes the mountain roads safer for night travelers.

sections.title: The Roadside Warning
sections.body: Travelers along the main thoroughfare south of Windshear Crag will spot a weathered wanted poster warning of the dangers to the west. Sishir Canyon and Webwinder Path have been completely overrun by eight-legged predators. At the heart of this webbed menace sits Besseleth, an unusually large, orange-hued spider who commands her brood and ambushes anyone daring to stray off the path after sunset.

sections.title: The Earthbinder's Grievance
sections.body: The bounty on Besseleth is offered by Maggran Earthbinder, a tauren resident of Sun Rock Retreat. Maggran has a personal score to settle with the matriarch: during a previous encounter, he was nearly killed when struck by Besseleth's massive two-foot fang. Though he managed to fight her off and limp to safety, the lingering wound serves as a constant reminder of the danger lurking in the canyon shadows. By having an adventurer claim Besseleth's Fang, Maggran hopes to secure the passes so trade and travel to Sun Rock Retreat can flourish without fear.

faq.q: Where does the quest Arachnophobia begin?
faq.answer: The quest is started by inspecting a wanted poster posted along the west side of the main road in the Stonetalon Mountains, just south of the entrance to Windshear Crag.
Besseleth lairs inside Sishir Canyon, located just west of the roadside wanted poster. She roams among her spider offspring across the canyon's web-choked ground.

Maggran Earthbinder is a tauren situated at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He personally survived a venomous strike from Besseleth and posted the bounty to rid the canyon of her menace.

faq.q: Why is Besseleth such a threat to the region?
faq.answer: Besseleth is an exceptionally large and ruthless spider who stalks Sishir Canyon and the neighboring Webwinder Path. She and her brood prey upon travelers under the cover of night, threatening anyone attempting to reach Sun Rock Retreat.

faq.q: What proof is required to claim the bounty?
faq.answer: You must slay Besseleth and sever one of her enormous two-foot fangs. Presenting Besseleth's Fang to Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat completes the bounty.

faq.q: Is this quest available to the Alliance?
faq.answer: No. The bounty poster awards credit to Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat, which is a Horde encampment, making Arachnophobia exclusive to the Horde.

angles.text: Clearing out Besseleth stabilizes travel into Sun Rock Retreat, protecting the Horde's vital foothold in the central crags of Stonetalon.
Maggran Earthbinder bears the painful scar of Besseleth's venom, making the hunt a matter of honoring and assisting a fellow son of the earth.
Tracking down an elusive, colossal arachnid within the shadowed crags of Sishir Canyon offers a true test of mountain stalking.
